audio_description:
Fire and shrapnel rake across the Garden's hull as a missile detonates.
A huge blast erupts on the grassy field below.
The Garden weathers the strike and pulls away.

context.scene_title: The missiles strike — explosions tear at the newly mobile Balamb Garden and the surrounding field (Disc 2).
